context: Tests whether the agent correctly implements the pr-nurse worktree sync-with-main procedure as a shell script: saving the current workspace path before switching directories, detecting the root repository via git worktree list --porcelain, verifying the root is clean before pulling, performing the pull, returning to the workspace, merging main without force, and noting the looping behavior for user awareness.

checklist.name: Save workspace path
checklist.description: Script captures the current working directory at startup (e.g., WORKSPACE=$(pwd) or equivalent variable assignment) before any directory changes

checklist.name: Root repo via worktree list
checklist.description: Gets the root repository path by running git worktree list --porcelain and parsing the first worktree entry — not a hardcoded or manually specified path

checklist.name: Navigate to root
checklist.description: Changes directory to the detected root repository path before running git pull

checklist.name: Check for local changes
checklist.description: Runs git status --porcelain (or equivalent) in the root repository to detect any uncommitted changes before pulling

checklist.name: Abort on dirty root
checklist.description: Exits or halts (non-zero exit code, explicit error message, or early return) without proceeding with the pull when local changes are detected in the root repo

checklist.name: git pull from root
checklist.description: Runs git pull from the root repository (without --force, --force-with-lease, or rebase flags that suppress safety checks)

checklist.name: Return to workspace
checklist.description: Returns to the saved workspace directory (using the captured path variable) after completing the root repo pull step

checklist.name: Merge main --no-edit
checklist.description: Runs git merge with the --no-edit flag to merge main into the worktree branch (not --squash, --rebase, or omitting --no-edit)

checklist.name: No force push
checklist.description: sync-with-main.sh does NOT contain git push --force or git push --force-with-lease anywhere in the file

checklist.name: Loop behavior documented
checklist.description: sync-with-main.sh or notes.md mentions asking the user whether to run continuously or on a loop after a single sync run completes
